title: Stability of Ginzburg-Landau pulses via Fredholm determinants of Birman-Schwinger operators
summary: We introduce a numerical method to determine the stability of stationary pulse solutions of the complex Ginzburg-Landau equation. The method involves the computation of the point spectrum of the first-order linear differential operator with matrix-valued coefficients on the real line obtained by linearizing the Ginzburg-Landau equation about a stationary pulse. Applying a general theory of Gesztesy, Latushkin, and Makarov, we show that this point spectrum is given by the set of zeros of a 2-modified Fredholm determinant of a Hilbert-Schmidt, Birman-Schwinger operator.
